tagline: The proven playbook — a black-car network on the water, already ramping.
summary: The Maldives is a nation of ~1,200 islands where every trip is a water trip — and where Navier's network model is already live. A ~100-vessel programme is ramping (Bloomberg/WSJ, 2026), replacing slow, weather-exposed transfers with fast, smooth, silent foiling. This is the reference market the rest of the world's archipelago opportunities are measured against.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: All-electric within-atoll resort transfers, silent and zero-emission, with berth-pedestal charging at resort jetties.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Hybrid range connects the dispersed atolls — Gaafu, Laamu, Addu and the far south — as single legs with no charging-infrastructure dependency, extending the network nation-wide.

signature_routes: Malé ↔ southern atolls (Gaafu / Addu) — long-haul hybrid
transit_planning: The Maldives is the operating reference: the network model, the unit economics and the guest experience proven here are the template Navier replicates in every other archipelago and resort-cluster market.
